task: Task 1: AQA AS Chemistry required practical 1–3, uncertainty and evaluation recall.

findings.finding: Historical back treats 1/t as relative initial rate unconditionally. It is a relative fixed-endpoint rate proxy; claiming exact initial concentration rate needs more conditions and data.
findings.action: Narrow the question to why 1/t is not automatically a rate in mol dm^-3 s^-1. Preserve existing core card ID and progress.

findings.finding: No direct AS Chemistry mock cards defined systematic or random error or explained the effect of repeat readings on systematic bias.
Existing cards described the rough titre and concordance but did not directly ask why the rough run is excluded from a concordant mean.
Heat loss to surroundings was covered; separate understanding of calorimeter heat capacity was not directly tested.

Existing cards covered fixed endpoints and 1/t units, but not observer judgement uncertainty, reactant concentration as a control during temperature changes, or graph-axis designation in this context.
